No movement in any direction. My body is completely frozen at (2,7).

Let me reconsider the possibility that this is a "the player must do it" situation, or that the notice board is a red herring and the real issue is that my body is a "ghost" that can't move. But the task is delegated to me.

Let me try one more creative thing: maybe the game responds to a "double-tap" or the movement needs the button pressed (not held). Let me try pressing (not holding) directions.
